settings.heading: Talk to a person
settings.text: Sizing, alterations, repairs, wholesale — whatever it is, we read every message and reply within two working days.
settings.subjects: General question, Order or delivery, Returns, Sizing and fit, Repairs, Wholesale, Press
settings.address:
18 Marlow Yard, London E2
Thursday to Sunday, 11am–6pm

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: You will have a tracking link in your dispatch email. If it has been more than five working days since that email, send us the order number and we will chase it.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.answer: Yes, if it has not shipped. Email us with the order number as soon as you can and we will catch it before it leaves the studio.

settings.question: Do you offer alterations?
settings.answer: We shorten sleeves and hems on tailoring at no charge within the first year. Send the piece back with a note and your preferred measurement.

settings.question: Do you sell wholesale?
settings.answer: To a small number of stockists each season. Use the wholesale subject above and tell us about your shop.

settings.heading: Most asked
settings.text: These four cover about half the messages we get.
